mapper.sql:
i.id, i.outbound_id, i.order_item_id, i.warehouse_id, i.sku_id, i.quantity, i.outbound_quantity, i.cost_price, i.amount, pr.product_name AS productName, pr.product_code AS productCode, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,
w.status AS warehouseStatus,
COALESCE(oi.spec_text, sk.spec_text) AS specText,
(inv.stock - inv.locked_stock) AS availableStock

FROM shop_erp_sale_outbound_item i LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product pr ON pr.id = sk.product_id AND pr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN shop_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.order_item_id AND oi.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_inventory inv ON inv.sku_id = i.sku_id AND inv.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND inv.is_deleted = 0
